entries.title: Acts 15:1
segments: ¶And certain [men] came down from Judea and taught the brethren, "Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved."

entries.title: Acts 15:2
segments: Therefore, when Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and dispute with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas and certain others of them should go up to Jerusalem, to the apostles and elders, about this question.

entries.title: Acts 15:3
segments: So, being sent on their way by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, describing the conversion of the Gentiles; and they caused great joy to all the brethren.

entries.title: Acts 15:4
segments: And when they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the church and the apostles and the elders; and they reported all things that God had done with them.

entries.title: Acts 15:5
segments: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, "It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command [them] to keep the law of Moses."

entries.title: Acts 15:6
segments: ¶Now the apostles and elders came together to consider this matter.

entries.title: Acts 15:7
segments: And when there had been much dispute, Peter rose up and said to them: "Men and brethren, you know that a good while ago God chose among us, that by my mouth the Gentiles should hear the word of the gospel and believe.

entries.title: Acts 15:8
segments: "So God, who knows the heart, acknowledged them by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as [He did] to us,

entries.title: Acts 15:9
segments: "and made no distinction between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

entries.title: Acts 15:10
segments: "Now therefore, why do you test God by putting a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

entries.title: Acts 15:11
segments: "But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved in the same manner as they."

entries.title: Acts 15:12
segments: Then all the multitude kept silent and listened to Barnabas and Paul declaring how many miracles and wonders God had worked through them among the Gentiles.

entries.title: Acts 15:13
segments: And after they had become silent, James answered, saying, "Men [and] brethren, listen to me:

entries.title: Acts 15:14
segments: "Simon has declared how God at the first visited the Gentiles to take out of them a people for His name.

entries.title: Acts 15:15
segments: "And with this the words of the prophets agree, just as it is written:

entries.title: Acts 15:16
segments: 'After this I will return And will rebuild the tabernacle of David, which has fallen down; I will rebuild its ruins, And I will set it up;

entries.title: Acts 15:17
segments: So that the rest of mankind may seek the LORD, Even all the Gentiles who are called by My name, Says the LORD who does all these things.'

entries.title: Acts 15:18
segments: "Known to God from eternity are all His works.

entries.title: Acts 15:19
segments: "Therefore I judge that we should not trouble those from among the Gentiles who are turning to God,

entries.title: Acts 15:20
segments: "but that we write to them to abstain from things polluted by idols, [from] sexual immorality, [from] things strangled, and [from] blood.

entries.title: Acts 15:21
segments: "For Moses has had throughout many generations those who preach him in every city, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath."

entries.title: Acts 15:22
segments: ¶Then it pleased the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas, [namely], Judas who was also named Barsabas, and Silas, leading men among the brethren.

entries.title: Acts 15:23
segments: They wrote this [letter] by them: The apostles, the elders, and the brethren, To the brethren who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: Greetings.

entries.title: Acts 15:24
segments: Since we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, "[You must] be circumcised and keep the law" --to whom we gave no [such] commandment--

entries.title: Acts 15:25
segments: it seemed good to us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

entries.title: Acts 15:26
segments: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Acts 15:27
segments: We have therefore sent Judas and Silas, who will also report the same things by word of mouth.

entries.title: Acts 15:28
segments: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things:

entries.title: Acts 15:29
segments: that you abstain from things offered to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality. If you keep yourselves from these, you will do well. Farewell.

entries.title: Acts 15:30
segments: So when they were sent off, they came to Antioch; and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

entries.title: Acts 15:31
segments: When they had read it, they rejoiced over its encouragement.

entries.title: Acts 15:32
segments: Now Judas and Silas, themselves being prophets also, exhorted and strengthened the brethren with many words.

entries.title: Acts 15:33
segments: And after they had stayed [there] for a time, they were sent back with greetings from the brethren to the apostles.

entries.title: Acts 15:34
segments: However, it seemed good to Silas to remain there.

entries.title: Acts 15:35
segments: Paul and Barnabas also remained in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

entries.title: Acts 15:36
segments: ¶Then after some days Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us now go back and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, [and see] how they are doing."

entries.title: Acts 15:37
segments: Now Barnabas was determined to take with them John called Mark.

entries.title: Acts 15:38
segments: But Paul insisted that they should not take with them the one who had departed from them in Pamphylia, and had not gone with them to the work.

entries.title: Acts 15:39
segments: Then the contention became so sharp that they parted from one another. And so Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus;

entries.title: Acts 15:40
segments: but Paul chose Silas and departed, being commended by the brethren to the grace of God.

entries.title: Acts 15:41
segments: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
